描述_EN: coffers with two drawers and two doors below the drawers are unknown before this date. the brass fittings are new but the timber shows signs of age. the doors also have wooden pins which are of one piece with the frame of the door panel. the dismemberment and reconstruction of pieces of furniture has been going on for centuries in china and this coffer is just one of many examples. this coffer, or storage cupboard, is considered a 20th-century product. this type of construction method is no longer used today.
描述_ZN: 带有两个抽屉和抽屉下面的两个门的棺材在这个日期之前是未知的。 黄铜配件是新的，但是木材显示出老化的痕迹。 门也有木销，与门板的框架是一体的。 在中国，对家具的肢解和重建已经持续了几个世纪，这个棺材只是众多例子中的一个。 这个棺材，或者说储存柜，被认为是20世纪的产品。 这种结构方式在今天已经不再使用。
